item.title: Rashee Rice Out for Season After Knee and Hamstring Surgery
item.description: Rashee Rice Injury UpdateKansas City Chiefs WR Rashee Rice is out for the remainder of the 2024 season after undergoing surgery to repair his LCL and a hamstring tendon. Rice was poised for a breakout year, but his absence now forces the Chiefs to turn to their remaining receiving options, such as JuJu, Worthy and Travis Kelce. This also opens the door for depth players to make an impact as Kansas City adjusts its offensive strategy.

item.title: Rashid Shaheed Out for Season After Meniscus Surgery, Saints WR Corps Thins
item.description: Rashid Shaheed Injury UpdateNew Orleans Saints WR Rashid Shaheed underwent a meniscus repair procedure and is now out for the remainder of the 2024 season. Shaheed sustained the knee injury during last week’s game against the Buccaneers. Initially, the Saints were optimistic for a minor procedure, but doctors determined a full meniscus repair was necessary. He has been placed on Injured Reserve and faces a 4-6 month recovery period, putting him on track to return for the 2025 season.

item.title: Derek Carr Moving to “Day-to-Day” Status, Week 8 Return Possible
item.description: Derek Carr Injury UpdateSaints QB Derek Carr, recovering from an oblique injury, is officially doubtful for Thursday night’s game against the Broncos. Head Coach Dennis Allen, however, mentioned that Carr is progressing into the “day-to-day” range, giving the team hope he may be back in time for Week 8. In the meantime, the Saints will turn to Spencer Rattler, who will make his second career start against Denver. Carr’s recovery remains a focus for the Saints as they navigate the season.

item.title: Nick Chubb’s Week 7 Workload: Cautious Approach on Tap for Browns RB
item.description: Nick Chubb Injury and Workload UpdateBrowns RB Nick Chubb is returning to action in Week 7, but Head Coach Kevin Stefanski has indicated that Chubb’s workload will be a “work in progress.” Given his recovery from last year’s multi-ligament knee injury, the Browns are taking a cautious approach to ensure his long-term availability. This limited role is expected for Chubb’s first game back, as the Browns prioritize gradual ramp-up over immediate production.

item.title: Najee Harris Misses Practice with Rib Issue, Likely Rest Day for Steelers RB
item.description: Najee Harris Injury UpdateSteelers RB Najee Harris did not participate in Wednesday’s practice due to a rib issue, raising questions about his availability for Sunday night’s game against the Jets. Harris is coming off a productive game against the Raiders, where he logged 14 carries for 106 yards. However, given the timing, this absence seems more likely to be a precautionary rest day rather than a significant injury. item.title: Davante Adams Set for Jets Debut After Hamstring Recovery
item.description: Davante Adams Injury UpdateJets WR Davante Adams, recently acquired from the Raiders, participated fully in Wednesday’s practice, signaling a significant improvement in his hamstring condition. Adams’ recovery coincided with his move from Las Vegas to New York, and he’s now poised to make his Jets debut on Sunday night against the Steelers. This development marks a key addition to New York's receiving corps as they prepare for a crucial AFC matchup.

item.title: Jordan Mason Limited with Shoulder Injury, 49ers’ RB Situation in Flux
item.description: Jordan Mason Injury Update49ers RB Jordan Mason was limited in Wednesday’s practice due to a sprained AC joint in his shoulder. Head Coach Kyle Shanahan has labeled Mason as "day-to-day," making him a true game-time decision for Sunday’s matchup against the Chiefs. With the 49ers facing the league’s top-ranked run defense, Mason’s availability will be crucial. If he’s unable to play, rookie Isaac Guerendo is expected to step in as the lead back for San Francisco.

item.title: Cooper Kupp Limited in Practice, Week 7 Status Uncertain
item.description: Cooper Kupp Injury UpdateRams WR Cooper Kupp was a limited participant in Wednesday’s practice, working through individual drills as he continues his recovery from an ankle injury. Head Coach Sean McVay expressed cautious optimism, stating that Kupp is “trending in the right direction” but will need to progress further before a final decision is made on his Week 7 availability against the Steelers. item.title: Malik Nabers Cleared from Concussion Protocol, Ready for Week 7
item.description: Malik Nabers Injury Update - Clears Concussion ProtocolGiants WR Malik Nabers has officially cleared the NFL's concussion protocol, according to reports. This clearance means Nabers is set to return to the field for Sunday’s divisional game against the Eagles. The rookie wideout missed the past two games, but after a full practice participation on Thursday, he’s ready to make his comeback. Nabers’ return bolsters the Giants’ receiving corps, providing QB Daniel Jones with a valuable deep threat
